title: QualityGate
description: The tenant's quality gate: the checks every vulnetix scan in CI must pass. When a check is set here it overrides the matching scan flag; a check left out leaves the flag in charge. One per tenant.

severity.description: Fail on any affected vulnerability at or above this severity. Overrides --severity.

exploits.description: Fail on a vulnerability with an exploit at or beyond this maturity. Overrides --exploits.

blockMalware.description: Fail when a dependency is known malware. Overrides --block-malware.

blockUnpinned.description: Fail on a dependency declared without a pinned version. Overrides --block-unpinned.

cooldownDays.description: Fail on a dependency version published fewer than this many days ago. Overrides --cooldown.

versionLag.description: Fail on a dependency more than this many releases behind the newest. Overrides --version-lag.

eol.description: End-of-life policy. A dependency whose product reaches end of life inside a horizon is reported at that horizon's severity, and blocks when it meets the gate.

block.description: Fail on end-of-life dependencies at all. Overrides --block-eol. The horizon severities are only read when this is true.

severities.description: The severity given to a dependency by how close its end of life is. skip ignores that horizon.

scaAutofix.description: How vulnetix fix and scan --sca-autofix choose a target version.

strategy.description: latest: the newest release. safest: the release with the fewest known vulnerabilities. stable: the newest release past its cooldown. rolling: the newest release that is not malware, known vulnerabilities allowed.

maxMajorBump.description: The most major versions a fix may jump. 0 keeps fixes within the current major.
